summary.en: If you lost, soiled or damaged your licence, apply for a reissue. Police stations in Nagoya (including Nishi and Minato) do not accept reissues. In Nagoya, go to the driving licence test centre (Tempaku Ward). The test centre and the Higashi-Mikawa centre issue it the same day. At the 23 police stations outside Nagoya you collect it on a later day (to be checked). The fee amount is not on the page (to be checked).

text.en: The driving licence test centre (Tempaku Ward), the Higashi-Mikawa centre, or these 23 police stations: Seto, Inuyama, Handa, Hekinan, Asuke, Kasugai, Ichinomiya, Tokai, Anjo, Shitara, Komaki, Inazawa, Chita, Nishio, Tahara, Nishibiwajima, Tsushima, Tokoname, Okazaki, Konan, Kanie, Kariya and Toyota. None of them is in Nagoya (to be checked)

text.en: 23 police stations: Monday to Friday, 9:00-16:00. Collected on a later day; the photo is taken on that day. If you change your address from another prefecture, you cannot apply at a police station (to be checked).

text.en: No service on Saturdays, public holidays, substitute holidays or 29 December to 3 January. On Sundays, only the test centre by reservation (to be checked).

text.en: ID: a photo ID such as a passport, My Number Card or residence card. Without a photo ID, several documents are needed (to be checked).

text.en: If you also change your address, bring one document showing the new address. A change of address from outside the prefecture cannot be accepted at a police station (to be checked).

text.en: Pay the fee with Aichi revenue stamps or cashless payment. Stamps of other prefectures are not accepted. The amount is not on the page (to be checked).

text.ja: マイナ{免許|めんきょ}{証|しょう}（マイナンバーカード）をなくしたときも、{再|さい}{交付|こうふ}の{対象|たいしょう}です。マイナンバーカードは{先|さき}に{一時|いちじ}{停止|ていし}します（{財布|さいふ}の{紛失|ふんしつ}の{案内|あんない}）。カードの{再|さい}{発行|はっこう}は{区役所|くやくしょ}です。{免許|めんきょ}の{情報|じょうほう}をカードに{入|い}れ{直|なお}す{順番|じゅんばん}は、{運転|うんてん}{免許|めんきょ}{試験場|しけんじょう}に{確|たし}かめてください（{要|よう}{確認|かくにん}）

text.en: Losing a My Number licence (My Number Card) is also a reason for reissue. Suspend the My Number Card first (see the lost wallet guide). The card is reissued at the ward office. Ask the test centre about the order for recording the licence on the card again (to be checked).

text.en: If you want a Mynumber-linked licence, bring your My Number Card (to be checked).

evidence.quote: マイナンバーカード（マイナ免許証を希望する場合）
免許証を亡失、滅失、汚損、破損したとき

lead.en: You must carry your licence when you drive. Do not drive while it is lost.
